basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Portland, Oregon, I’ve been a Redditor for nearly a decade. By day, I work as a graphic designer with a focus on custom sneaker designs, which is both my passion and profession. I’m a huge fan of alternative hip-hop, with a special love for MF DOOM and They Might Be Giants. I believe in the power of blockchain and have dabbled in cryptocurrency mining on and off. My online hours are typically in the evenings and late at night due to my freelance schedule. I'm currently single and enjoy attending local music events and sneaker conventions whenever possible.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design from a local art college and have been customizing sneakers for over a decade, gaining recognition through social media and online communities. My interest in music is rooted in my teenage years, where I explored underground hip-hop and indie music. My knowledge in cryptocurrency is largely self-taught, stemming from online forums and practical experimentation.
